beliefs: f splits the input on whitespace runs, reverses each segment, and joins with single spaces [E1-E5]
Case and punctuation are preserved and reversed with their segment [E1, E2]
Leading/trailing whitespace is dropped and internal runs become single spaces [E3, E4]
The last output segment gets one extra copy of its own last character appended [E4, E5]
The extra character is the last character of the reversed last segment, not from the preceding segment [E5]
notes: Added the rule that the final reversed segment has its last character duplicated; verified against E5 (e.g. 'x y z'->'x y zz', 'ab cd ef'->'ba dc ffe', 'a bc'->'a ccb').
